## [1.1.0](https://github.com/weird-aftertaste/quetta-privacy-patches/compare/v1.0.3...v1.1.0) (2026-11-01)

### ✨ New Features

* support the official 2.0.9 APK from quetta.net ([3ea1258](https://github.com/weird-aftertaste/quetta-privacy-patches/commit/3ea1258d9736a6c1525847f4084973de6e36f07b))

patches.name: Disable update and push endpoints
patches.description: Points the component update and push registration hosts at a non-resolvable domain. Component and ad-block list updates stop, and push notifications do not arrive.

patches.name: Harden network security config
patches.description: Disables cleartext traffic in base and domain configurations and drops trust in user-installed CAs.

patches.name: Remove QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
patches.description: Drops android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES from the manifest. May degrade installed-app detection.

patches.name: Strip analytics endpoints
patches.description: Points usage reporting, crash reporting and telemetry beacon hosts at a non-resolvable domain, so they cannot be uploaded.

patches.name: Strip analytics endpoints from native libraries
patches.description: Rewrites analytics and crash reporting hosts in lib*.so, which bytecode patches cannot reach.

patches.name: Strip update and push endpoints from native libraries
patches.description: Rewrites update and push hosts in lib*.so, which bytecode patches cannot reach.

patches.name: Strip vendor endpoints from native libraries
patches.description: Rewrites Quetta vendor endpoints in lib*.so, which bytecode patches cannot reach.

patches.name: Strip vendor tracking endpoints
patches.description: Points the favicon proxy, start page, video sniffing and share link hosts at a non-resolvable domain. Site icons and start page suggestions stop loading.
